kinds.description: PII/secret kinds detected in this row.
kinds.title: Kinds

backend_used.description: The recognizer backend actually used (regex | regexset | presidio).
backend_used.title: Backend Used

total.description: Total non-empty rows read (sampled count when sampled).
total.title: Total

rows_with_pii.description: Rows containing at least one match.
rows_with_pii.title: Rows With Pii

secret_rows.description: ADR-0080 P1 — rows carrying at least one leaked secret, counted over the FULL corpus (not the sample). None when secrets_full_scan is off.
secret_rows.title: Secret Rows

counts.description: Per-kind total match count across the dataset.
counts.title: Counts

findings_truncated.description: True when `findings` hit the max_findings cap (#891) — `counts` and `rows_with_pii` are still exact; only the enumerated detail was capped.
findings_truncated.title: Findings Truncated

sampled.description: True when the check ran over a reservoir sample, not every row.
sampled.title: Sampled

sample_size.description: Rows sampled when `sampled` is true; None when the full dataset was scanned.
sample_size.title: Sample Size
